Offering More Than AI TRiSM

Portal26 is more than an essential GenAI Visibility, Insight and AI TRiSM platform for GenAI strategy leaders. Portal26 also provides a strong data security solution that secures enterprise search platforms.								
				
				

				

									
A Pioneering Enterprise Search Security Solution

Our award-winning enterprise security encryption plugin  not only offers strong  data security, but also advanced controls such as BYOK and HYOK. All of Portal26’s cryptographic algorithms are NIST FIPS 140-2 validated and provide granular field level evidence of encryption for day-to-day scenarios and for incident investigations.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
						

					

			

						

				

					
The Most Powerful Enterprise Search Data  Security Solution  On The Market				
				
				

				

									
For data security, data privacy, and granular encryption and key-management based controls for enterprise search platforms such as AWS Opensearch and Elasticsearch, Portal26 is the multi-award winning solution that can help.								
				
					
		
					
		
				
							

							

					

			

					

						
						

					

			

						

				

					Plugin Features				
				
					
		
					
		
				

				

									
NIST FIPS 140-2 certified Encryption
API Encryption for complete system lock-down
Companion proxy for just-in-time query level decryption
BYOK/HYOK (Bring Your Own Key/ Hold Your Own Key)
Customer controlled keys
Real-time Key-Derivation
Zero Downtime Key Rotation

						Portal26 provides a low friction way to deploy encryption across the enterprise so that data can be protected even when in use. Compared to tokenization, Portal26 is lightweight, adaptable and lightning-fast. Add to that scalability and flexibility in deployment and what you have is a game-changer for data privacy and protection.					
					Kurt JohnGlobal CISO, Expedia Group				
						

									

						
											
											
		
								
											

									

							

					

						"Portal26 has come to the market with interesting new solutions that keep data usable and proportionate levels of security for the business problems at hand. Data security has been a passion of mine for over 20 years and I look forward to watching Portal26’s progress in solving pervasive data problems.”					
					Jim ReavisFounder, and CEO of Cloud Security Alliance				
						

									

						
											
											
		
								
											

									

							

					

						Protecting sensitive data while it is used is the next frontier of data protection. Since the bulk of privacy and security issues are taking place with access credentials, it is really important for enterprises to have a default state for their data that is private and secure at all times, including when it is actively being used.					
					Vishal GuptaGlobal CTO & CIO, SVP Connected Technology at Lexmark
